title: SimulationRun
description: Schema for a single Hegselmann-Krause simulation run result.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the simulation run.

seed.description: Random seed used for this run.

network_size.description: Number of nodes in the network.

convergence_time.description: Number of iterations until convergence, or null if non-convergent.

final_opinions.description: Final opinion vector of all agents.

temporal_trace.description: Full temporal trace of opinion vectors (optional, for sensitivity analysis).
